accessibility.contrast_ratio: Ensure 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text.
accessibility.focus_states: Visible ring-2 ring-teal-600 ring-offset-2 on all interactive elements.

universal_guidelines: All interactive elements MUST have a `data-testid` attribute.
Do not use generic gradients; use the defined 'neuro_hero' or 'teacher_fun' gradients.
Use 'Manrope' for headings in Admin/Parent, 'Fredoka' for Teacher.
Teacher interface must be touch-first: large buttons, no small links.
Parent interface must be mobile-first: stackable cards, bottom navigation on mobile.
Admin interface is density-first: use tables and grids effectively.
Do not use 'Inter' font; use the specified font stack.
instructions_to_main_agent: You are building the frontend for Harmoni OS. Follow the 'role_specific' styles strictly. When building the Teacher Dashboard, force the use of 'Fredoka' font and large rounded buttons. For Admin, stick to 'Manrope' and dense layouts. Use the provided image URLs for placeholders. Ensure all forms use 'react-hook-form' and 'zod' validation (if applicable in the stack) or standard Shadcn forms.
